evidence.detail: The renderer exits unless Client.cH equals rs/n/c/aD.bI; R2 already resolves rs/n/c/aD as BloodFountainPerkTreeInterface from the exact '<img=186> Blood Fountain Perk Tree <img=186>' title and perk-tree vocabulary.

Its constructor hardcodes 27 exact Blood Fountain perk labels and coordinates, including Blood vengeance I/II, Treasure hunter I/II, Blood whip, Blood rune c'bow, Blood dark bow, Bloodthirsty I/II, Killjoy I/II, Blood pool, Blood staff, Blood ring, Bloodlust, Excavator, War diamonds, Unholy smite, Eternal recoil, Eternal blood cape, Vampiric damage and Vampiric defence.
The live renderer lazily loads exactly 'fountain/sprite 1', 'fountain/sprite 2' and 'fountain/sprite 3' and selects among them per perk state/selection.

The overlay draws each perk node at its stored interface-relative coordinates, hit-tests the 32x32 perk regions, emits the exact perk label as hover text, tracks the selected index and writes the exact client command '::selectperk <index>' on selection.

Its public state methods toggle individual perk-entry states and externally set the selected perk index, matching a runtime interactive selection overlay layered over the static Blood Fountain perk-tree interface.

proposals.note: BloodFountainPerkSelectionOverlay is fixed by the existing BloodFountainPerkTreeInterface identity, exact fountain sprites, 27 exact perk names, hover/selection behavior and ::selectperk command path. Confidence is 0.999.

evidence.detail: rs/l/c/e is a four-field mutable record with one String label, x/y coordinates and one small integer presentation state; its constructor fixes the label/coordinates and initializes state to 0.

Exact v308 rs/l/c/f creates 27 of these records and is the only recovered consumer in this subsystem, using the label for hover text, x/y for screen placement and state as the index into the three fountain/sprite presentation states.

The owning overlay populates entries with exact Blood Fountain perk names including 'Blood vengeance I/II', 'Blood whip', 'Blood rune c\'bow', 'Blood dark bow', 'Bloodthirsty I/II', 'Blood pool', 'Blood staff', 'Blood ring', 'Bloodlust', 'War diamonds', 'Vampiric damage' and 'Vampiric defence'.
The same owner renders these entries only while the exact BloodFountainPerkTreeInterface root is active, binding the record role to that interface rather than a generic coordinate record.

proposals.note: BloodFountainPerkEntry is descriptive exact-behavior recovery for the per-perk label/position/presentation-state record consumed exclusively by the Blood Fountain perk selection overlay. No original source identifier is claimed; confidence is 0.998.
